name: Ano Orgel o Wasurenai
original_name: あのオルゴールを忘れない
source:
One day, the protagonist finds a music box, which she is then sucked into; she's transported into another world. In that world, will she fall in love with her companions or return home? Will a game show take place? It all depends on you!

[translated from [url=http://lightbreeze.ivory.ne.jp/game/anooru.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
有一天，主角发现了一个音乐盒，她被吸了进去；她被传送到了另一个世界。在那个世界里，她会爱上同伴还是回家？会举办游戏表演吗？这一切都取决于你！

[翻译自[url=http://lightbreeze.ivory.ne.jp/game/anooru.htm]官方网站[/url]]
